title.narrative: Large Scale Restoration: Unlocking Private Finance for Para's PES Fund

description.narrative: Establish a structure for a scalable ‘Payment for Ecosystem Services’ fund, with an embedded MRV mechanism to enable landholder beneficiaries to register and monitor agroforestry and restoration projects, engaging private climate financing and thus diminishing landholder restoration costs.
